title: Covered-Repair Benefit Limits — Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements
content:
Covered repairs are a benefit of the top Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements tiers. The table sets, per tier, the benefit granted per term, the most the benefit pays on one service call, and the waiting period.

| Tier | Covered-repair benefit granted per term (USD) | Per-incident cap: most the benefit pays on one service call (USD) | Waiting period (calendar days after the agreement's first covered-repair grant) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Comfort Club Basic | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Comfort Club Silver | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Comfort Club Gold | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Comfort Club Platinum | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Comfort Club Platinum Plus | 1500.00 | 750.00 | 30 |
| Comfort Club Total Home | 3000.00 | 1500.00 | 30 |

## Meaning

- A benefit per term of **0.00** means the tier carries no covered repairs. Only Comfort Club Platinum Plus and Comfort Club Total Home carry them.
- The **per-incident cap** is the covered-repair per-incident cap: the most the benefit pays on one service call.
- The **waiting period** is counted in calendar days after the agreement's first covered-repair grant, before a newly booked repair can be covered.

## Side-by-side for the two covering tiers

| | Comfort Club Platinum Plus | Comfort Club Total Home |
|---|---|---|
| Benefit per term | 1500.00 | 3000.00 |
| Per-incident cap | 750.00 | 1500.00 |
| Per-incident cap as a share of the term benefit | one half | one half |
| Waiting period | 30 days | 30 days |
